title: Harness Metrics Row
description: Engine-agnostic per-row schema for the core/HARNESS_METRICS.md emit contract. schemaVersion is versioned independently of governanceVersion. No storage-engine commitment (JSONL, SQLite, or otherwise) is implied by this schema.

consumerId.description: Declaring consumer's identifier, e.g. its governance manifest project name.

gateRunId.description: Correlates this row to a specific gate run, audit, board review, or waiver event, where applicable.

status.description: MUST be 'absent' or 'deferred' rather than a fabricated zero when the family was not run or is not yet instrumented (no-silent-zero rule, core/HARNESS_METRICS.md).

value.description: Family-specific measured value. MUST be null when status is not 'measured'.
